response.overview: The Lost Game tells the little-known story of a barnstorming basketball team created by Lamar Hunt during club’s early years as the Dallas Texans, which served as an innovative offseason effort that evolved into a decades-long tradition connecting communities and raising money for local causes.  Spanning the organization’s early days in Dallas through its move to Kansas City, discover how what began as a creative promotional initiative became a lasting piece of sports and civic history – bringing together players, fans, and communities across generations.  Featuring interviews and perspectives from Chiefs legends and sports figures including Pro Football Hall of Famers Bobby Bell, Willie Lanier, and Will Shields, alongside contributors such as Chiefs Chairman and CEO Clark Hunt, longtime team historian Bob Moore, and Kansas City Royals Legend George Brett. Animation by ‪@2TallAnimation‬
response.tagline: The Lost Game: The Untold Story of the Kansas City Chiefs Basketball Team
response.title: The Lost Game
